author: reek
body: GPU-accelerated sparse matrix solver stubs for SPICE simulation. Defines the kernel interface for direct and iterative linear system solvers operating on compressed sparse row data. The solver back-end dispatches to GPU compute kernels via the Device effect when available and falls back to CPU iteration otherwise.

author: reek
body: Functional update: returns a new vector with the element at the given index replaced. Rebuilds the value list via index scan.

author: reek
body: Dot product of two vectors computed by recursive walk over the value lists.

author: reek
body: Euclidean norm: square root of the dot product with itself. Uses Newton's method for the square root approximation.

author: reek
body: Returns the density of the sparse matrix as a percentage: the number of stored nonzero elements over the total number of cells.
